title: DepRisk reach-request v1
description: Protocol: what the DepRisk CLI sends to the reachability analyzer (deprisk-reach) on stdin. Everything below 'root' is analyzed as one program. Unknown properties are ignored by the analyzer; an unknown schemaVersion is rejected.

mode.description: auto: Main, top-level statements, controllers, hosted services. public-api: public members of public types (libraries). none: only 'explicit'.

explicit.description: Namespace.Type.Method (all overloads) or Namespace.Type.* (every member of the type), added to the mode's entrypoints.

key.description: Opaque; the result is reported under it.

symbols.description: Namespace.Type.Member, Namespace.Type.#ctor, or Namespace.Type.* (any member, including constructors).

complete.description: True only if the list is claimed to contain every public way to reach the flaw. Without it, a missing path is 'unknown', never 'unreachable'.
